# T-1: Guarantee post-hook deferral

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add the missing final-FAIL lifecycle transition so semantic test-review retry exhaustion carries findings to flow-findings.json during updateReviewRetryCounter or an equivalent review post-hook path.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R1 final semantic FAIL at maxAttempts writes flow-findings.json in the same command lifecycle.
- R3 test-review is marked done through the existing traversal model after deferred completion.
- R4 pre-check and post-hook paths share carryover behavior.

## Implementation Notes
Reuse tryDeferReviewRetryExhaustion, deferExhaustedSemanticFindings, or a shared helper extracted from them. Ensure attempts uses the incremented value attemptsBefore + 1 at post-hook time.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests and focused unit tests that construct a test-review FAIL artifact and flow metrics where attemptsBefore + 1 reaches maxAttempts, then verify flow-findings.json and step status after the post-hook path.
